title: The `insightsClient` option has not been provided to `instantsearch`
body:
When I click anywhere on my search result it show a error on console

**The `insightsClient` option has not been provided to `instantsearch`**

The same in your netlify example as well - https://instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/search/?query=books

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Search anything
2. Click on the search result items

How can I fix this?
